800224.description_en:
We deliver reliable, scalable and high-performance backend development and server setup services tailored to your needs.

WHAT WE OFFER

Backend development
- Modular REST APIs with Node.js & Express
- Secure authentication with JWT/tokens + RBAC
- MongoDB (Mongoose) schema, index and query optimization
- Real-time features (Socket.io/WebSocket)
- File uploads and CDN/cloud storage (Cloudinary/S3)
- Postman/Swagger documentation, optional Jest tests

DevOps / go-live
- Nginx (1.24+) reverse proxy on Ubuntu 22.04 LTS
- Zero-downtime deploys with PM2 (cluster mode)
- Let's Encrypt SSL with automatic renewal
- DNS/domain management (A/AAAA, CNAME, TXT, SPF/DKIM/DMARC)
- Logging & monitoring (pm2/nginx), backups and .env management

CONCRETE KPIs & SLA (targets/benchmarks)
- Uptime: 99.9% SLA
- API p95 response time: < 200–400 ms (Express + correct indexing)
- TTFB improvement: 30–60% (Nginx cache, brotli/gzip, keep-alive)
- Deploy downtime: 0 s (PM2 reload/graceful)
- RPS (example 2 vCPU VPS): 1k–3k req/s on read-heavy endpoints
- 5xx error rate: < 0.5% (health checks + rate limiting)
- Backups: daily (7-day) + weekly (4-week) retention
- SSL renewal check: automatic cron every 60 days
- Cold start to live: < 5 min (optional CI/CD)

SECURITY DEFAULTS
- OWASP Top 10-focused review
- Rate limiting: default 100 requests/min/IP (configurable)
- Passwords: bcrypt 12+ rounds; JWT access 15 min / refresh 7 days
- Cookies: httpOnly, secure, sameSite; domain-scoped CORS

ENVIRONMENT & VERSIONS
Node.js 18/20 LTS, Express, MongoDB 6/7, Nginx 1.24+, PM2 5.x, Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, Postman/Swagger, Git/GitHub.

DELIVERABLES
- Source code + README/runbook
- Postman collection / Swagger
- Nginx + PM2 configurations, SSL/DNS records
- Short-term support (Q&A / minor fixes)

If you want an end-to-end, measurable solution for backend development or a production launch with Nginx + PM2 + DNS + SSL, let's bring your project live together.

850998.description_en:
We make your website visible not only on Google, but also in ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity.

What is GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)?
Users increasingly reach information through AI assistants. GEO measures and improves how your site is perceived by these systems — and whether it gets cited.

AUDIT SCOPE

GEO & AI Visibility
- AI citability score (0–100)
- Readiness status for ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews
- AI crawler access review (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, etc.)
- llms.txt standard compliance
- Schema.org / JSON-LD structured data audit
- Brand awareness and reference visibility across AI systems

Technical SEO
- robots.txt, sitemap.xml and canonical URL checks
- Meta tags, Open Graph, Twitter Card
- Internal link structure and anchor text analysis
- Index/noindex status

Lighthouse & Core Web Vitals
- Performance score (LCP, INP, CLS metrics)
- Mobile friendliness and accessibility
- Resource optimization (JS, CSS, images)

DELIVERED REPORT
A professional PDF including score gauges, a platform-by-platform readiness table, a prioritized action plan and technical notes you can hand directly to your developer.

Sites we have previously audited include energetische-massage-bonn.de, paketjet.com, sportoonline.com, guezelwebdesign.com and more.

A URL is all we need — no site access required.
